title.en: Chapter 15 — The Man of the Island

sentences.ar: وأنا هارب، شفت إشي بيتحرك بين الشجر.
sentences.en: While fleeing, I saw something moving among the trees.

sentences.ar: طلع زلمة شعره طويل وتيابه من جلد.
sentences.en: It was a man with long hair and clothes of skin.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا بن غن، من تلات سنين هون.
sentences.en: He said: I am Ben Gunn, three years here.
The sailors left me on this island alone.
He asked me: do you have cheese?

sentences.ar: وقال: أنا بعرف كل إشي عن فلينت.
sentences.en: And he said: I know everything about Flint.
And he had a small boat hidden.
